model.maintenance: one positive geometric scale per algorithm applied to execution-driven maintenance cycles
model.reader: non-negative OLS shared by SSSP and CC: rounds + processed edges
model.compute: non-negative OLS shared by SSSP and CC: rounds + range tasks + processed edges
model.iterative_span: non-negative OLS shared by SSSP and CC: rounds + range tasks + processed edges
model.total: predicted maintenance plus predicted iterative span; zero-round residual PageRank is maintenance-only

mechanism_mapping.rounds: reader/compute kernel launch, control, and drain per device round
mechanism_mapping.range_tasks: HLS range-task and tile service work
mechanism_mapping.processed_edges: actual edge payloads consumed by the routed reader/compute path

supersedes.reason: The frozen v12 one-scale Spine timing model failed on WK/R19 even though routed rounds, range tasks, processed edges, and memory ledgers matched. V13 promotes those inspected rows to calibration and freezes an HLS-work model before PK/LJ08 execution. G+R remains governed by the independently frozen v12 model.
